content.comment_body: HELP! Why doesn't the up/down counter output turn off automatically when the count reaches zero? I expect it to be ON when it's one or higher and OFF at zero. Why is a manual reset needed to turn it off? Threshold parameters: ON threshold: 1 OFF threshold: 0 [user_name]

Hello, The OFF function works as described in the [document]: ON activates when the value is greater than or equal to the ON threshold (>=) OFF activates when the value is less than the OFF threshold (<) If both thresholds are set to 1, the counter should function as you expect, because 0 is less than 1. Hope that clarifies the behavior.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is confused about the up/down counter logic. Specifically, the counter does not switch OFF at zero as the user expects. The product follows its defined threshold logic, which requires manual resetting at zero, creating unexpected behavior compared to the user's intention.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the counter to automatically turn OFF when the value is zero, and remain ON for any value one or higher, without needing to manually reset the counter.
